hooks.command: bash -c 'S=$(cat .claude/current_session.txt 2>/dev/null || echo unknown); if echo "$S" | grep -qi merge; then echo "Merge session — assessment not required"; else if [ ! -f "docs/assessments/session-${S}-assessment.md" ]; then echo "BLOCKED: Assessment file missing for session ${S}" >&2; exit 2; fi; if [ ! -f "docs/sessions/SESSION_0${S}.md" ]; then echo "BLOCKED: Session log missing: docs/sessions/SESSION_0${S}.md" >&2; exit 2; fi; fi; if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then echo "BLOCKED: Uncommitted files" >&2; git status --porcelain >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0'

bash -c 'WARN=0; for f in $(git diff --name-only HEAD~1 2>/dev/null | grep "\.py$"); do HITS=$(grep -nE "^[^#]*\bprint\(|^[^#]*\bbreakpoint\(" "$f" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$HITS" ]; then echo "WARNING: debug statements in $f:" >&2; echo "$HITS" >&2; WARN=1; fi; done; if [ $WARN -eq 1 ]; then echo "Consider removing debug print()/breakpoint() before session end." >&2; fi; exit 0'
echo 'WARNING: /compact is BANNED in Rhodesli. Use /clear instead. /compact is lossy and causes instruction amnesia. This will be logged as a RED FLAG in session assessment.' >&2 && exit 0

bash -c 'REPO=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo "."); T="$REPO/.claude/commits_since_clear.txt"; C=0; if [ -f "$T" ]; then C=$(cat "$T" | tr -d "[:space:]"); fi; if [ "$C" -ge 2 ] 2>/dev/null; then echo "" >&2; echo "BLOCKED: $C commits without /clear. Run /clear FIRST." >&2; echo "Lesson 89: Sessions 80+89 both failed from this exact mistake." >&2; echo "" >&2; fi; echo "PARALLELIZATION CHECK: Before starting, analyze this prompt for parallel opportunities. Independent phases (different files) can use worktree-isolated subagents. Max 3-4 worktrees. Merge: docs first, then code."'

bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get(\"tool_input\",{}).get(\"command\",\"\"))" 2>/dev/null); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "\bgit commit\b"; then if [ -f .claude/parallel_session_active ]; then BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current); if [ "$BRANCH" = "main" ]; then echo "BLOCKED: Cannot commit to main during parallel session." >&2; exit 2; fi; fi; REPO=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo "."); bash "$REPO/scripts/test-gate.sh" fast 2>&1 | tail -5; fi'

bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(echo "$INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin).get(\"tool_input\",{}); print(d.get(\"file_path\",d.get(\"path\",\"\")))" 2>/dev/null); if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE "(rhodesli_ml|core)/.*\.py$"; then echo "REMINDER: Update ALGORITHMIC_DECISIONS.md if this changes ML behavior." >&2; fi'
bash -c 'S=$(cat .claude/current_session.txt 2>/dev/null || echo "?"); osascript -e "display notification \"Session ${S}: Awaiting input\" with title \"Claude Code\"" 2>/dev/null; exit 0'
